'''Mark Ponting''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Parker tournament]] on 2 December 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops with Ominous Rumors and TIE swarm]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1517">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mamad1517/ parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mama], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-07-parker-co-12-2-00-somebody-call-my-mamad1517/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
